audit.whatIsWrong: full.diff read HARD while breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t both said 'Even matchup - difficulty 5.5/10'.
audit.why: 55% over 20 games with a 5.5/10 rating is not a hard matchup, and the rest of the file already labels it even.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike in either layer carried a cooldown.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s and Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s. Miasma at 24 seconds is the single number this lane runs on, because Riftwalk is unusable inside the cloud.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[9].t and loading now name 24s and 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer already had the two big interactions right (Miasma grounding blocks Riftwalk; Petrifying Gaze stuns only if you face her), but the full layer never carried the facing rule, and neither layer said that Twin Fang is weak against an unpoisoned target or that Noxious Blast speeds her up on hit.
audit.why: Riot: 'Twin Fang ... deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her'; 'Noxious Blast ... granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion'; and Serpentine Grace makes 'All Move Speed bonuses ... more effective on Cassiopeia'. Dodging the Q therefore removes both her damage amp and her chase.
audit.corrected: Wrote the facing rule into report[5].t and loading, and the poison-prerequisite into breakdown.trading, report[3].t and content.whys[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this matchup as having NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and it was right - every window was described as 'when Miasma is down' with no duration.
audit.why: Miasma 24s at rank 1 versus Riftwalk's 5s means you get several blinks per cloud cycle; Twin Fang's 0.75s cooldown means she never stops casting, which is also why Force Pulse is always charged in this lane.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull, report[9].t and phases[2].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' - right instinct, wrong pronoun, and it never named the source.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt on a 0.75-second cooldown, which is the sustain that makes her poison trades free.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Cassiopeia 'he'/'his' and described her as a juggernaut.
audit.why: Cassiopeia is female and is a ranged poison mage.
audit.corrected: Fixed tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[1], dontsFull[1].t, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.trading, report[0].t, report[3].t, report[8].t, report[9].t and report[11].t.
